title: Graph Additive Models disentangling feature, topology, and interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.20662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Additive Networks (GNANs) have emerged as effective, interpretable-by-design architectures for graph learning. They achieve transparency by combining per-feature shape functions with simple distance-based reweighting. However, GNANs have three limitations. First, node-wise relevance scores aggregate information from all graph nodes, allowing irrelevant nodes to inherit spurious relevance from relevant ones. Second, topology is represented only through shortest-path distances, so structurally distinct graphs may share identical distance profiles. Third, feature and distance information are combined multiplicatively, entangling feature, distance, and interaction effects in a single rescalable term. We introduce AMIGA, which represents topology through a vocabulary of mined motifs and decomposes each node contribution into three additive channels: feature, structure, and feature-structure interaction. translated_title: 解耦特征、拓扑与交互的图加性模型
translated_abstract: 图神经加性网络（GNANs）已成为一种有效的、具备内建可解释性的图学习架构。它们通过将逐特征的形状函数与简单的基于距离的重加权相结合来实现透明性。然而，GNANs存在三个局限性。第一，节点级相关性得分聚合了来自图中所有节点的信息，使得无关节点可能从相关节点继承虚假的相关性。第二，拓扑仅通过最短路径距离来表示，因此结构不同的图可能具有完全相同的距离特征。第三，特征与距离信息以乘法方式结合，导致特征、距离和交互效应被纠缠在同一个可缩放项中。我们提出AMIGA，它通过挖掘出的模体词汇表来表示拓扑结构，并将每个节点的贡献分解为三个加性通道：特征、结构以及特征-结构交互。这些通道被中心化……
tldr: 提出AMIGA模型，通过挖掘的图模体表示拓扑结构，并将节点贡献分解为特征、结构和交互三个加性通道，从而解决了图神经加性网络中虚假相关性传递和效应纠缠的问题。
en_tdlr: AMIGA disentangles feature, topology, and interaction effects in graph additive models by representing topology with a vocabulary of mined motifs and decomposing node contributions into three additive channels: feature, structure, and feature-structure interaction.
